tools.name: unw_accept_proposal
tools.description: Accept the locked approved proposal, creating a contract and initial invoice if applicable.

tools.name: unw_add_approval_step
tools.description: Add the next person to a proposal approval chain.

tools.name: unw_add_proposal_section
tools.description: Add a reusable section as a new open proposal part.

tools.name: unw_add_requirement_evidence
tools.description: Attaches a section, attachment, library item, or note as evidence for a requirement. Requires proposals:write.

tools.name: unw_add_review_comment
tools.description: Add a review comment or reply, with internal or client visibility.

tools.name: unw_add_review_flag
tools.description: Flag an unbounded item that blocks approval until addressed.

tools.name: unw_admin_add_org_member
tools.description: Create or change a user's organization membership and role.

tools.name: unw_admin_create_org
tools.description: Create a client organization.

tools.name: unw_admin_create_user
tools.description: Create a user, optionally connecting them to an organization.

tools.name: unw_admin_delete_mcp_client
tools.description: Delete a registered MCP client and revoke all tokens it issued.

tools.name: unw_admin_delete_proposal
tools.description: Delete an eligible proposal and dependent draft data with an audit entry.

tools.name: unw_admin_list_orgs
tools.description: List organizations and their members.

tools.name: unw_admin_list_scope_presets
tools.description: List predefined API token scope bundles.

tools.name: unw_admin_list_tokens
tools.description: List issued API/MCP tokens.

tools.name: unw_admin_list_users
tools.description: List users, organizations, and memberships.

tools.name: unw_admin_mint_magic_link
tools.description: Create a time-limited user sign-in link.

tools.name: unw_admin_mint_token
tools.description: Issue a token using explicit scopes or a scope preset.

tools.name: unw_admin_prune_mcp_clients
tools.description: Remove unused self-registered MCP clients older than the configured TTL; keep staff-created and demo clients.

tools.name: unw_admin_revoke_token
tools.description: Revoke an issued token.

tools.name: unw_agree_part
tools.description: Mark a drafted proposal part as agreed by the client, or move it back to drafted or open.

tools.name: unw_analyze_rfp_requirements
tools.description: Reads RFP text into proposed requirements, suggests proposal sections, and flags duplicates. Nothing is approved. Requires proposals:write.

tools.name: unw_apply_credit
tools.description: Apply an eligible unexpired credit to an invoice; staff only.

tools.name: unw_approve_content_library_item
tools.description: Approves or rejects a library version that is in review. Approval is staff-controlled and makes that version the one inserts copy. Requires proposals:write.

tools.name: unw_archive_content_library_item
tools.description: Archives a library item so new inserts cannot use it. History is kept. Staff only. Requires proposals:write.

tools.name: unw_assign_proposal_task
tools.description: Assigns a proposal-manager task to an owner with an optional section, requirement, dependency, priority, and deadline. Completing a task does not approve a section. Requires propos

tools.name: unw_attach_proposal_document
tools.description: Upload a new PDF or Markdown file onto a proposal.

tools.name: unw_charge_invoice
tools.description: Charge a sent invoice through the payment processor, then mark it paid.

tools.name: unw_compare_proposal_versions
tools.description: Compares two proposal versions using the existing review diff engine. Read-only. Requires proposals:read.

tools.name: unw_create_catalog_draft
tools.description: Create an editable catalog draft from the current published version.

tools.name: unw_create_chat_session
tools.description: Create a persisted chat session for a proposal, contract, or project manager agent.

tools.name: unw_create_compliance_matrix
tools.description: Maps extracted requirements to proposal sections and evidence. A mapping is not automatically a human compliance sign-off. Requires proposals:write.

tools.name: unw_create_custom_section
tools.description: Create a section with its own title, guidance, and character limit.

tools.name: unw_create_delivery_project
tools.description: Creates a delivery project from a signed contract. The contract and project route enforce staff and organization rules. Requires projects:write.

tools.name: unw_create_go_no_go_assessment
tools.description: Creates a weighted go/no-go assessment. The score is advisory; recording a final decision is staff-controlled. Requires proposals:write.

tools.name: unw_create_invoice
tools.description: Create a draft invoice, subject to billing rules.

tools.name: unw_create_pricing_model
tools.description: Creates a versioned proposal pricing model using server-side integer minor-unit calculations. It does not approve discounts or margins. Requires proposals:write.

tools.name: unw_create_proposal
tools.description: Create a proposal with scope, deliverables, milestones, engagement, and catalog-constrained pricing.

tools.name: unw_create_scope_baseline
tools.description: Creates an immutable versioned scope baseline with items, assumptions, exclusions, and risks. Requires proposals:write.

tools.name: unw_decide_change_item
tools.description: Record an approved or declined decision on a pushback or change request.

tools.name: unw_delete_proposal_attachment
tools.description: Delete one stored proposal document.

tools.name: unw_deliver_reminders
tools.description: Send eligible reminders with quiet-hour, cap, retry, and duplicate protections.

tools.name: unw_draft_proposal_section
tools.description: Drafts one proposal section from approved library answers that match its requirements. Unmatched requirements stay as named gaps. Nothing is invented. Requires proposals:write.

tools.name: unw_duplicate_proposal
tools.description: Copy a proposal into a new draft with its timeline, options, and completion structure.

tools.name: unw_export_proposal
tools.description: Export a proposal in a supported format.

tools.name: unw_export_redline
tools.description: Download a Word file with tracked changes between two proposal versions.

tools.name: unw_extend_proposal_expiry
tools.description: Let staff extend a proposal before acceptance, within configured limits.

tools.name: unw_extract_rfp_requirements
tools.description: Persists agent-confirmed requirements extracted from a proposal source document. Requirements remain unmapped until explicitly mapped through the compliance matrix. Requires propos

tools.name: unw_fetch_proposal_document
tools.description: Download a public https PDF or Markdown file onto a proposal.

tools.name: unw_find_guidance_cases
tools.description: Finds staff-approved past cases that resemble this proposal's current situation: what was going on, what the agent did, the lesson, and whether it worked or should be avoided. Use them as examples, not scripts. Optional move narrows to cases about one move. Read-only; never sets hours or price. Requires proposals:read.

tools.name: unw_get_billing_schedule
tools.description: Read billing entries and planned charges tied to a contract.

tools.name: unw_get_catalog
tools.description: Read the active published pricing catalog, with no special catalog scope.

tools.name: unw_get_catalog_draft
tools.description: Read published and draft catalog data for authorized editors.

tools.name: unw_get_completion_tree
tools.description: Read proposal completion nodes, dependencies, completion percentage, and history.

tools.name: unw_get_compliance_matrix
tools.description: Returns coverage, mandatory gaps, duplicate conflicts, and low-confidence requirements. Read-only. Requires proposals:read.

tools.name: unw_get_content_library_item
tools.description: Loads one library item and its version history. Requires proposals:read.

tools.name: unw_get_invoice
tools.description: Load one invoice by ID.

tools.name: unw_get_pending_client_decisions
tools.description: Lists unresolved requirements, open or blocked tasks, undecided go/no-go state, and unapproved pricing that need client or staff attention. Requires proposals:read.

tools.name: unw_get_project
tools.description: Load a project by ID.

tools.name: unw_get_proposal
tools.description: Load a proposal by ID.

tools.name: unw_get_proposal_attachment
tools.description: Return the signed-in download path for one stored proposal document.

tools.name: unw_get_proposal_expiry
tools.description: Read valid-until date, expiry state, and days remaining.

tools.name: unw_get_proposal_progress
tools.description: Read a client-facing progress summary and the next recommended step.

tools.name: unw_get_proposal_status
tools.description: Read lifecycle and review status, version lock, and outstanding comments or flags.

tools.name: unw_get_reminder_options
tools.description: List supported channels, tickler schedules, and default quiet-hour settings.

tools.name: unw_get_service_info
tools.description: Report MCP and API health, token scopes, and tools hidden from this caller.

tools.name: unw_ingest_rfp
tools.description: Stores an RFP or other source document against a proposal. The agent may then extract confirmed requirements from it. Requires proposals:write.

tools.name: unw_insert_approved_content
tools.description: Copies approved, non-expired library content into one proposal section and returns its provenance. Requires proposals:write.

tools.name: unw_invite_proposal_guest
tools.description: Adds a coworker to the portal so they can view this proposal. Creates their sign-in account when needed. sent is false: this does not email them. They sign in with the usual email link. Requires proposals:write.

tools.name: unw_invoice_hours
tools.description: Generate a draft invoice for billable, uninvoiced time in a range.

tools.name: unw_link_proposal_document
tools.description: Attach a PDF or Markdown document by https URL.

tools.name: unw_list_agent_traces
tools.description: List redacted agent tool-call traces, errors, and execution times for staff review.

tools.name: unw_list_change_items
tools.description: List pushback deadlines, pushbacks, and change requests.

tools.name: unw_list_chat_messages
tools.description: Read stored messages in a chat session.

tools.name: unw_list_chat_sessions
tools.description: List chat sessions the caller can access.

tools.name: unw_list_compliance_requirements
tools.description: Lists compliance requirements for a proposal. Requires proposals:read.

tools.name: unw_list_consult_intakes
tools.description: List consultation requests and their linked proposal IDs.

tools.name: unw_list_consult_offerings
tools.description: List active consultation options and their configured limits and pricing.

tools.name: unw_list_credits
tools.description: List an organization’s Workflow Check credits; staff only.

tools.name: unw_list_deliveries
tools.description: Inspect reminder delivery attempts, channels, statuses, and errors.

tools.name: unw_list_follow_up_queue
tools.description: Show proposals awaiting staff attention, ranked by configured reasons and urgency.

tools.name: unw_list_guidance_events
tools.description: Lists recent guidance-playbook turns for a proposal: the signals computed, which rules fired, the suggested moves and their client phrases, and the action taken when one was recorded. Read-only. Never sets hours or price. Requires proposals:read.

tools.name: unw_list_hours
tools.description: List recorded time entries on a contract.

tools.name: unw_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices visible to the caller.

tools.name: unw_list_parked
tools.description: List deferred change or intake items.

tools.name: unw_list_payment_terms
tools.description: Read available payment terms and the default.

tools.name: unw_list_projects
tools.description: List projects visible to the caller.

tools.name: unw_list_proposal_attachments
tools.description: List PDF and Markdown documents stored on a proposal, in display order.

tools.name: unw_list_proposal_roles
tools.description: List project roles on a proposal, including which phases they are heaviest in.

tools.name: unw_list_proposal_sections
tools.description: List the sections belonging to a proposal.

tools.name: unw_list_proposal_tasks
tools.description: Lists proposal-manager tasks, including overdue task ids. Requires proposals:read.

tools.name: unw_list_proposal_templates
tools.description: List active templates, expected parts, example content, and optional packages.

tools.name: unw_list_proposal_views
tools.description: Summarize who opened a proposal and which parts they opened.

tools.name: unw_list_proposals
tools.description: List proposals visible to the current authenticated caller.

tools.name: unw_list_reminders
tools.description: List generated reminders for expiring, waiting, or stalled proposals.

tools.name: unw_list_review_feedback
tools.description: List visible review comments, flags, and review status.

tools.name: unw_list_section_library
tools.description: List reusable narrative sections with guidance and length limits.

tools.name: unw_list_tools
tools.description: List every tool with input names and a read, edit, or commit label.

tools.name: unw_lock_node
tools.description: Lock a completion node to a proposal version.

tools.name: unw_log_hours
tools.description: Record contract work hours; refuse entries exceeding a contractual cap.

tools.name: unw_map_requirement_to_section
tools.description: Links a requirement to proposal sections. A mapping is not compliance sign-off. Requires proposals:write.

tools.name: unw_mark_part_unsure
tools.description: Mark a part for human discussion or defer it without treating it as failure.

tools.name: unw_open_change_item
tools.description: Record a pushback deadline, formal pushback, or change request.

tools.name: unw_park_change
tools.description: Save a requested change for phase two or a swap without disturbing locked work.

tools.name: unw_park_item
tools.description: Save an intake item for a future proposal rather than expanding current scope.

tools.name: unw_pay_invoice
tools.description: Record an invoice as paid; does not itself run a payment processor.

tools.name: unw_preview_change_impact
tools.description: Preview which dependent parts would reopen after a change.

tools.name: unw_preview_commitment
tools.description: Previews the contract terms and first invoice that accept would create. dryRun is true. It does not accept the proposal, sign a contract, or create an invoice. Requires proposals:r

tools.name: unw_publish_catalog
tools.description: Validate and publish a pricing version, superseding the previous version.

tools.name: unw_recommend_handoff
tools.description: Recommend a call with staff and explain why handoff is appropriate.

tools.name: unw_record_approval
tools.description: Record that one approval-chain step is done.

tools.name: unw_release_retainage
tools.description: Create the invoice releasing previously withheld retainage; staff only.

tools.name: unw_remaining_hours
tools.description: Read hours allowed, used, and remaining at the catalog rate.

tools.name: unw_remove_proposal_section
tools.description: Removes one section (part) from a proposal. Removing a section the proposal no longer has is a no-op, so retries are safe. Locked sections and sections with sub-parts are refused. Never sets hours or price. Requires proposals:write.

tools.name: unw_reopen_proposal
tools.description: Reopen an approved proposal for editing; clears the approval.

tools.name: unw_reorder_proposal_attachments
tools.description: Set the display order of every document on a proposal.

tools.name: unw_reorder_proposal_sections
tools.description: Reorders a proposal's sections. The listed keys move to the front in that order and the rest keep their order after them. Give parentKey to reorder sub-parts of one section; omit it for top-level parts. Returns the new order. Never sets hours or price. Requires proposals:write.

tools.name: unw_replace_proposal_attachment
tools.description: Replace one stored proposal document by id.

tools.name: unw_request_free_consult
tools.description: Record a consultation request and create the linked draft proposal.

tools.name: unw_resolve_review_comment
tools.description: Resolve a review comment, subject to actor permissions.

tools.name: unw_resolve_review_flag
tools.description: Resolve a review flag, including automatic unbounded flags.

tools.name: unw_resubmit_proposal
tools.description: Resubmit a revised proposal as the next version.

tools.name: unw_review_decision
tools.description: Record staff approval, rejection, or requested changes; blocking flags prevent approval.

tools.name: unw_review_proposal
tools.description: Score narrative sections against database-configured review rules; read-only.

tools.name: unw_run_reminders
tools.description: Compute and optionally queue due reminders using configured rules.

tools.name: unw_save_proposal_template
tools.description: Saves this proposal's sections, written text, phases, roles, and scope as an inactive template. Staff only. It does not publish the template. Requires proposals:write.

tools.name: unw_search_content_library
tools.description: Searches library content. Callers see approved, non-expired items in their organization or marked global. Each hit includes why it matched and its approval state. Staff may filter

tools.name: unw_select_proposal_options
tools.description: Select prepriced options and packages without changing their prices.

tools.name: unw_send_chat_message
tools.description: Send a message and return the persisted assistant response.

tools.name: unw_send_invoice
tools.description: Change a draft invoice to sent using the API rules.

tools.name: unw_set_contact_preference
tools.description: Save reminder channel, destination, explicit consent, opt-out, and quiet hours.

tools.name: unw_set_contract_billing_terms
tools.description: Set payment term and retainage percentage; staff only.

tools.name: unw_set_phase_estimate
tools.description: Set a low and high hour and week estimate on existing phases.

tools.name: unw_set_proposal_roles
tools.description: Replace the project roles on a proposal.

tools.name: unw_set_proposal_template
tools.description: Chooses the template a proposal is built from. On a draft, a different template rebuilds the parts and keeps written text for parts that exist in both. The same template again is a no-op. Locked or non-draft proposals cannot change template. Never sets hours or price. Requires proposals:write.

tools.name: unw_set_tickler
tools.description: Schedule, snooze, repeat, or stop proposal-completion reminders.

tools.name: unw_sign_contract
tools.description: Sign a contract and generate billing entries without duplicating them on retries.

tools.name: unw_sign_off_compliance
tools.description: Records a staff compliance sign-off. Refuses while any mandatory requirement lacks an accepted mapping. Requires proposals:write.

tools.name: unw_start_revision
tools.description: Start the client's revision after changes were requested.

tools.name: unw_start_staff_review
tools.description: Take a proposal into staff review so a decision can be made.

tools.name: unw_submit_content_library_item
tools.description: Submits the current draft version for staff review. Requires proposals:write.

tools.name: unw_submit_proposal_for_review
tools.description: Submit a draft for agent review and create a version snapshot.

tools.name: unw_unlock_node
tools.description: Unlock a node and return dependent parts to review as needed.

tools.name: unw_update_billing_schedule_line
tools.description: Change an installment or billing schedule line in a draft.

tools.name: unw_update_compliance_requirement
tools.description: Corrects a proposed requirement. Set confirmed when a person accepts the wording. Requires proposals:write.

tools.name: unw_update_invoice_policy
tools.description: Change draft invoicing policies.

tools.name: unw_update_price_tier
tools.description: Change a price tier in a catalog draft.

tools.name: unw_update_proposal_section
tools.description: Edit proposal title, scope, timeline, pricing, or a configured narrative section.

tools.name: unw_update_review_comment
tools.description: Rewrite or supersede the caller own open review comment.

tools.name: unw_upload_proposal_part
tools.description: Upload one small part of a PDF or Markdown file.

tools.name: unw_upsert_content_library_item
tools.description: Creates a library item or drafts a new version. An approved item stays insertable until the new version is approved. Client visibility requires a client label. Requires proposals:w

tools.name: unw_upsert_proposal_document
tools.description: Create or replace a PDF or Markdown file on a proposal by filename.

tools.name: unw_validate_commercial_policy
tools.description: Validates a proposal pricing model against supplied margin and discount thresholds. Read-only; it does not approve the price. Requires proposals:read.

tools.name: unw_validate_proposal_readiness
tools.description: Checks mandatory requirements, blocked tasks, go/no-go status, and pricing approval state before submission. Read-only. Requires proposals:read.

tools.name: unw_void_invoice
tools.description: Void an eligible unpaid invoice.

tools.name: unw_withdraw_proposal
tools.description: Withdraw a proposal on the client's behalf with a reason.
